meta.purpose: Rockies Express owner rows: Tallgrass Energy LP 100 percent after Phillips 66 sold its 25 percent in June 2024 (sibling fix to P7814)

verifications.note: Phillips 66's annual report for 2025 says it sold its 25 percent ownership interest in Rockies Express Pipeline LLC on 14 June 2024.
An NS Energy story from June 2024 says Phillips 66 sold its 25 percent stake in Rockies Express to a Tallgrass Energy subsidiary.
Vinson and Elkins, counsel on the deal, says Tallgrass Energy will own 100 percent of the common equity in Rockies Express after the sale.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Tallgrass Energy LP owns all of Rockies Express Pipeline LLC. Phillips 66 held the other 25 percent until it sold that stake to a Tallgrass subsidiary on 14 June 2024, as its annual report for 2025 says. The sheet showed Tallgrass Energy at 75 percent and Phillips 66 at 25 percent, which was true before the sale. The older Securities and Exchange Commission and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filings in this cell supported that split, so they are replaced. Same change as P7814 Decatur Lateral.
